snippet.title: I Made A PVP Smithing Game
snippet.description:
🎮 Play A Smithing Game Here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4541460/A_Smithing_Game/ 🎮

For the past 8 months, I have been working on an online multiplayer game called A Smithing Game. In this game, you smith weapons and fight other players with them. Let me know what you think of A Smithing Game in the comments or by leaving a review on Steam!

=== Links ===

Discord: https://discord.gg/XdgwrB6cDB

PurrNet: https://purrnet.dev/

Client Side Prediction Video: https://youtu.be/GcDFfpGypZM?si=1bmMPepre1fTgwz5

Texturing Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9ITJgW9hVrE

This video was edited by Toxiquid: https://www.youtube.com/@toxiquid

Hammad's ArtStation: www.artstation.com/hammadshahid

This video’s music comes from me and the Youtube Audio Library.
